glm-ocr-q8.name: GLM-OCR 0.9B
glm-ocr-q8.why: the shipped reader (config.llm.yaml `local-ocr`); prompts from its model card

paddleocr-vl-1.6.name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 0.9B
paddleocr-vl-1.6.quant: the repo's only build (unquantized), projector likewise
paddleocr-vl-1.6.llama_cpp: upstream since PR #18825 (2026-02-19); the repo ships its chat template beside the GGUF
paddleocr-vl-1.6.why: asked for by the product owner; Apache-2.0, same size as GLM-OCR; 1.6 is a drop-in successor of 1.5 (same architecture, per its card), so 1.5 is not run separately

mineru2.5-pro-q8.name: MinerU2.5-Pro-2605 1.2B
mineru2.5-pro-q8.quant: Q8_0, projector Q8_0; a community conversion (no official GGUF exists), the most downloaded one; its projector is byte-identical to mradermacher's
mineru2.5-pro-q8.llama_cpp: upstream: a Qwen2-VL architecture. Its OTSL cell tokens are special tokens, which llama-server drops from the text unless it runs with --special (-sp); without it the tables pass comes back as cells run together with no separator
mineru2.5-pro-q8.why: the other document-OCR model of this size with a permissive license; prompts and penalties from mineru-vl-utils (`DEFAULT_PROMPTS`, `DEFAULT_SAMPLING_PARAMS`)

lightonocr-2-q8.name: LightOnOCR-2 1B
lightonocr-2-q8.why: added: Apache-2.0, 1B, an official ggml-org GGUF; it takes no prompt, so it is one pass
lightonocr-2-q8.status: not measured: the owner limited the comparison to small OCR models

qwen3-vl-2b-q4.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct (reference)

passes.text: Transcribe all the text in this image exactly as printed, in reading order. Output only the text.
passes.tables: Convert every table in this image to HTML using <table>, <tr> and <td>. Copy every cell exactly as printed, including empty cells. Output only the HTML.

qwen3-vl-2b-q4.why: a general vision model as a reference; no task prompts of its own, so the two passes are written to match the reader's
qwen3-vl-2b-q4.status: not measured: the owner limited the comparison to small OCR models

dots-ocr-q8.name: dots.ocr 1.7B

passes.text: Extract the text content from this image.
passes.tables:
Please output the layout information from the PDF image, including each layout element's bbox, its category, and the corresponding text content within the bbox.

1. Bbox format: [x1, y1, x2, y2]

2. Layout Categories: The possible categories are ['Caption', 'Footnote', 'Formula', 'List-item', 'Page-footer', 'Page-header', 'Picture', 'Section-header', 'Table', 'Text', 'Title'].

3. Text Extraction & Formatting Rules:
    - Picture: For the 'Picture' category, the text field should be omitted.
    - Formula: Format its text as LaTeX.
    - Table: Format its text as HTML.
    - All Others (Text, Title, etc.): Format their text as Markdown.

4. Constraints:
    - The output text must be the original text from the image, with no translation.
    - All layout elements must be sorted according to human reading order.

5. Final Output: The entire output must be a single JSON object.

dots-ocr-q8.why: asked for; prompts are `prompt_ocr` and `prompt_layout_all_en` from dots_ocr/utils/prompts.py (its table-only prompt is commented out there)
dots-ocr-q8.status: not measured: the owner limited the comparison to small OCR models
